topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students, outlines the course structure and student backgrounds, and introduces the core learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Biological basis of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer as a progressive failure of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture driven by accumulated genetic changes, and address the challenge of modeling this in vitro.

topics.label: Distinguishing benign from malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the diagnostic criteria that separate benign from malignant neoplasms, including their capacity for invasion and metastasis, their morphological progression, and their formal nomenclature.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physiological and mechanical processes through which primary and metastatic tumors cause systemic illness and patient death.

topics.label: Tumor incidence across tissues and species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare patterns of tumor frequency and mortality across human tissue types and diverse animal species.

topics.label: Clinical detection and cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical presentation of tumors and the rationale, efficacy, and challenges of screening programs across various cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by revisiting the learning outcomes and providing closing announcements.
